items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Octave played the piano. I see. And when, when Octave go, I just play the guitar until he come back, you see.

ctx.x: I started at, I played way back in the middle thirties with Dad and Octave. He hired me on the guitar at the Dryad Street Carnival Club, you ever heard of that?
